dc_title_s: Culvert Inventory, City of Oshkosh, WI 2026
dc_description_s: This data represents culverts for the City of Oshkosh, Wisconsin in 2026. [Overview: This data provides an inventory of culvert structures used in stormwater and roadway drainage management. It captures location, jurisdiction, ownership, structural characteristics, and inspection details for individual culverts. Content Inventory records document culvert locations and associated municipal or county context. Structure details describe culvert type, material, total structure length, and the feature carried over and under the structure. Inspection and maintenance information includes inventory date, critical findings, inspector name, and comments. Administrative fields support record tracking, editing history, and completion status. Geographic Coverage: The data covers a localized area within Wisconsin, supporting municipal and county stormwater infrastructure management. Use Cases: Tracking culvert assets and their physical characteristics Supporting inspection, maintenance, and inventory workflows Managing drainage infrastructure for transportation and stormwater planning, Documenting ownership and jurisdictional responsibility.]
uw_supplemental_s: This is an archived copy of the data held at UW-Madison.
